subject: Re: Admin activity capture matrix & on-demand proof delivery for NovaMed
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novamed.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: NovaMed Security Team <security@novamed.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Admin activity proof request for SOC 2/ SIG Qs

Hi Jasmine,

We're preparing the next stage of our SOC 2 submission and the SIG/CAIQ follow-up. The auditors asked for an example export showing the kinds of admin/admin-api events you retain for customer accounts (role changes, API key rotation, model-promotion/deploy, emergency disables, privilege elevation, and operator sessions).

Specifically we need:
- A 24-hour sample (any 24-hour window in the last 30 days) showing schema fields and anonymized identifiers.
- Confirmation of retention windows for admin activity (per-tenant) and any elevated-privilege retention policy.
- Export delivery options (S3 presigned, SFTP, encrypted signed manifest) and verification method (HMAC/SHA256).

Can you provide a sample and short notes on the items above? We'll include the sample in our SIG evidence bundle.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Director, Information Security
NovaMed

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novamed.com>
Cc: NovaMed Security Team <security@novamed.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity proof request for SOC 2/ SIG Qs

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear list. We can do that. Quick summary up front, and I'll attach a scrubbed NDJSON sample and the manifest:

What we capture (examples):
- actor_id (internal user/service principal) — hashed per-customer on export
- timestamp (ISO 8601, UTC-normalized)
- action_type (role_grant, role_revoke, api_key_create, api_key_rotate, model_deploy, config_change, emergency_suspend)
- resource (object path, e.g., /orgs/{org}/projects/{proj}/models/{model})
- prev_state / new_state (diff summary for config changes)
- request_id (globally unique request id)
- session_id (operator session id, when available)
- client_ip (redacted or prefix-preserved depending on PII requirements)
- svc_kv_refs (references to KV cache keys affected)

Retention summary:
- Default admin activity retention: 365 days (per-tenant).
- Privileged action snapshots (role grants, emergency disables, key rotations) are retained for 3 years by default for customers with compliance add-on; otherwise 1 year.
- Raw operator session recordings (where applicable) are kept for 90 days unless a longer legal hold is requested.

Export & verification options:
- Delivery: SFTP (preferred for compliance teams), AWS S3 presigned URLs (us-east-1 by default), or encrypted transfer to a customer-managed bucket (cross-account role).
- File format: newline-delimited JSON (ndjson), gzipped, schema versioned (admin_activity.v1).
- Integrity: Signed manifest (CSV) with per-file SHA256 and a manifest HMAC signed with our KMS-backed key. We can also provide a signed attestation PDF.

I'll loop in our ops team to prepare the 24-hour sample for your auditors and confirm the exact window. Questions: do you need IPs fully redacted, or is prefix-only (e.g., 10.1.xxx.xxx) acceptable for your SIG submission?

Attaching: admin_activity_sample_20270708.ndjson (scrubbed), admin_activity_manifest_v1.csv, export_instructions_novamed.pdf

— Jasmine
Product Security Liaison
Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>

Kimberly / Marcus — FYI / action needed. NovaMed (Ellen) wants a 24-hour sample plus confirmation of retention and delivery options. Requirements:

- Include the signed manifest with SHA256 per file and HMAC of the manifest.
- For this customer we should prefix-redact client_ip (first two octets kept) unless they push back.
- Delivery to SFTP path: sftp://evidence.redwood.com/novamed/2027-07-08/ (temp creds) or upload to presigned S3 and share link.

Can you run the export and provide ETA? Auditor prefers delivery within 24 hours. I'm attaching my note to the customer and the sample we will send.

Thanks — Jasmine
